goal: Refactor authentication across the API and web packages, then review the migration.

units.title: API auth refactor
units.objective: Move refresh-token rotation into the auth service without changing the public API contract.
acceptance: A used refresh token cannot be replayed.
A valid refresh token rotates once and keeps the session alive.
units.deliverable: Branch, commit, push, and PR against main.
units.brief:
ROLE: implementation
OBJECTIVE: Move refresh-token rotation into the auth service without changing the public API contract.

CONTEXT
- Repo /work/app
- Base branch main at 4f2c1a
- Read AGENTS.md and services/auth/README.md

WRITE SCOPE
- services/auth/**
- tests/auth/**

DO NOT TOUCH
- web/**, infra/**, shared/**

ACCEPTANCE
- A used refresh token cannot be replayed.
- A valid refresh token rotates once and keeps the session alive.
- pnpm test --filter auth passes.

DELIVERABLE
- Branch auth-refresh-rotation, commit, push, PR against main.
- Report the PR URL, head SHA, and check status.

units.title: Web auth client
units.objective: Update the web client to handle refresh-token rotation and one retry after a 401.
acceptance: A 401 triggers one refresh attempt and retries the request.
A failed refresh logs the user out.
units.deliverable: Branch, commit, push, and PR against main.
units.brief:
ROLE: implementation
OBJECTIVE: Update the web client to handle refresh-token rotation and one retry after a 401.

WRITE SCOPE
- web/auth/**
- web/tests/auth/**

DO NOT TOUCH
- services/**, infra/**

ACCEPTANCE
- A 401 triggers one refresh attempt and retries the request.
- A failed refresh logs the user out.
- pnpm test --filter web-auth passes.

DELIVERABLE
- Branch web-auth-rotation, commit, push, PR against main.
- Report the PR URL, head SHA, and check status.

units.title: Security review
units.objective: Review both auth PRs for replay, expiry, concurrent refresh, and error-path defects.
acceptance: Findings are ordered by severity with file:line and concrete fixes.
Replay, expiry, concurrent refresh, and error paths are explicitly covered.
units.deliverable: Review memo with findings and a verdict.
units.brief:
ROLE: review
OBJECTIVE: Review both auth PRs for replay, expiry, concurrent refresh, and error-path defects.

INPUTS
- PRs: <api PR URL> and <web PR URL>
- Base: main at 4f2c1a
- Design: docs/auth-rotation.md

WRITE SCOPE: none.

DELIVERABLE
- Findings by severity with file:line and concrete fixes.
- If no findings, list what you checked.

RULES
- Do not edit the branches.
- Do not trust the PR descriptions; read the diffs.

integration.notes: Merge the API change first; the web client can tolerate a rotating token after its own merge.

fallback: If no implementation target meets the depth, do the smaller unit in the parent and keep the independent unit delegated.
